Executive Summary

A New Category of Entertainment

Fixed to the Power of None is not a film. It is not a TV series. It is a live, sports-reactive narrative system that plays out alongside real football matches every weekend — delivered entirely through YouTube Live and Telegram, platforms where the audience already lives.

The Story

One repeatable story world — Kamau, Erico, Ngash, debt, Nairobi. Same crisis, every week. Outcomes change.

The Mechanic

Live sports scores trigger live scene switches. Every goal reshapes what the audience watches in real time.

The Audience

Sports bettors on Telegram. Thriller fans on YouTube. No new app. Zero behaviour change required.

The Stakes

Erico’s survival is the win condition. The community’s multi-bet determines whether he lives or dies — every week.

The Story — In Sixty Seconds

A debt. A vote. A clock.

01 · THE DEBT

Erico owes the wrong man

Erico borrowed 2.5M shillings from Ngash to bail his pregnant wife out of jail. The wife is gone; the child is raised next door by Purity. Erico works in Ngash's club to pay back a debt he doesn't know was engineered — by Ngash himself.

02 · THE VOTE

The audience holds the slip

Each week the community votes a free 5-leg Premier League poll. That consensus becomes Erico's accumulator in the show. Win: the debt delays, Erico goes home to his child. Lose: the flash-forward creeps closer.

03 · THE CLOCK

The ending was shown first

The season opens with 90 seconds of flash-forward: an empty bar, Erico gone, "38 weeks earlier." Every Saturday, live football decides whether that future happens — and in week 38, the accumulator chooses which ending airs.

Kamano
"Kamano Kimani, 70, is dying — and has spent a lifetime hiding the truth about Erico. His estate is the reason Kamau came home. Ngash's debt is the reason Erico might not live to see it."Kamano and Felix were never blood — they were friends who fought over the same woman, then over business. Thirty years later, Felix is still collecting.
Underneath the mechanic: Kamano abandoned Njeri and Erico. Felix — his old friend turned enemy — abandoned her too and built an empire to ruin him. Ngash destroyed Erico's wife. The weekly vote is a vote that Erico becomes the first to stay: to know his child, face the truth about his father, and not run.

The Shape of the Season

Thirty-eight weeks. Four movements. Two endings.

WKS 1–13

The debt story

The community watches a man work for his enemy. Purity warns. Phillip circles. Ngash performs.

WKS 14–15

The act-two break

Felix learns Kamau has the phone and the thread. The amusement ends. Everything after is a conspiracy thriller.

WK 22

The midseason turn

Kamau shows Erico the documents. Eric Kimani. Your name is on these. Erico does not sign. He stays to understand.

WK 27

The explosive reveal

Purity tells Erico the truth about his wife. The community realises it has been voting to keep alive a man who did not yet know the full reason he deserved to live.

WKS 31–35

The camera

Kamau begins filming. The documentary is the weapon nobody in a pre-internet criminal network thought to account for. The video surfaces: Phillip, at the Apex, the night Lucy disappeared. Not Ngash. Phillip.

WK 38

The convergence

Win: Erico walks out with Kamau; the opening image was a departure, not a death. Fail: Erico is gone; the documentary publishes anyway; Season 2 is Kamau's story. Two endings, shot before the season begins. The audience's vote decides which one was true.

The glass layer · the show through the audience’s phone

The glass layer — data over the film

Survival odds HUD, debt clock, leg status and poll consensus ride over the stream as glass data overlays. Motion graphics, not filmed — zero marginal cost, updated in real time inside the 15-second window.

Positioning, locked: viewers vote, no real-money betting. The show dramatises and exposes the harms of betting and match-fixing; it never promotes participation. Any future real-money integration requires a licensed operator who carries the regulatory liability.
The Conspiracy — Revealed One Layer Per Act

One trap. Four layers. Thirty-eight weeks.

LAYER 1 · THE DEBT · WKS 1–8

Working for the enemy

A man working for his enemy every day without knowing it. The audience learns what Erico knows: the amount, the deadline, the trap.

LAYER 2 · THE THREAD · WKS 9–17

Fixed matches, laundered money

Ngash controls a Telegram thread of pre-determined matches belonging to Felix's network — real fixed matches, used to launder money, sold as fake tips to ordinary punters. Erico has known for months. He has been trying to find a way out from inside.

LAYER 3 · THE BLOOD · WKS 18–26

The inheritance has a name

Erico's father is not a dead policeman. Kamano Kimani — dying in Boston — is his biological father. Kamau is his half-brother. The documents in Kamau's jacket carry Erico's name: Eric Kimani. The child in Githurai is a Kimani heir without knowing it.

LAYER 4 · THE BETRAYAL · WKS 27–38

Why the debt was engineered

Ngash had Erico's wife framed because she chose Erico over him — then lent Erico the bail money. Underneath: Kamano, Felix and Paul Kobia were in the same gang decades ago. Felix survived the order to eliminate him, and has held that knowledge over everyone since.

How the ARG works: Friday the poll locks → Saturday real Premier League goals fire Sportradar webhooks → within 15 seconds the live stream switches pre-shot story modules and Telegram drops in-character threats → Sunday the community verdict meme spreads. The audience does not watch a fixed script; they push the story toward survival or collection. Two mechanics, one engine: granular — each real match controls one story variable; binary — the season-long vote chooses which of two filmed endings airs in week 38. No leak. No spoiler. No fixed script.
The Format — What Actually Changes

One story. Two layers. Never the same show twice.

LAYER 1 · GRANULAR

Each match controls one story variable

Does the money arrive in time? Does Ngash's enforcer find Erico? Does the tip-off land — or get intercepted? Does Kamau's ally hold — or betray? Real fixtures decide, live.

LAYER 2 · BINARY

The season-long vote

Does Erico survive the debt — or does the syndicate collect? Every weekly outcome pushes the season toward one of two endings, shot before the season starts. The audience won't know which until it happens, live, in front of them.

The Kimani family
Theo, Kamau and Kamano — the inheritance that starts everything

Why two layers beat one script

A scripted show ships one ending. This format ships two and lets real football choose — no leak, no spoiler, no repeat.

The trigger is the goal. The variable is the story beat. The destination is one of two filmed endings.

How the Live System Keeps the Story Coherent

Every second of airtime is typed: RX reactive present · OR oral backstory (confession-guarded) · SC sacred flashback (triggers queued, released as one return-burst) · JD Judgment · LK locked flash-forward · SP spine-only.

A goal never interrupts a reveal — it recolors the present. Modules carry texture; plot moves only in spine, Judgment, flash-forward. Max one switch per 90s; extras become glass ticks. No valid module → the glass layer acts. The show never dead-airs.

The ledger (location × state) is the continuity governor. Week 30 Erico matches Week 1 Erico because the ledger says so.

Audience — Why It Grows And Returns

Unspoilable. Unmissable. Unmissed.

Appointment viewing by design

Live football cannot be spoiled. The story switches on real goals, so watching late means watching a result you already know. Saturday 16:00 becomes a ritual, not a reminder.

The vote is the retention loop

People return to see the consequence of their own vote. The poll closes Friday; the result plays Saturday. Vote → consequence → return is the strongest loop in interactive television — and it costs nothing to run.

Two audiences, one funnel

Passive viewers get a complete thriller without ever touching Telegram. Players get in-character threads, threat drops and leaderboards. Lurkers convert to players weekly — never required, always tempting.

The week never goes quiet

Mon poll opens → Tue/Wed shorts → Wed Ngash threat → Thu Erico address → Fri lock → Sat live → Sun verdict meme. Seven touchpoints a week, all inside channels the audience already checks. Zero new apps.

Sunday verdict meme
Sunday verdict — the community distributes the show for us
Kamau gets the news
Tue–Wed story drops pull lurkers one step deeper
Growth is built into the output: meme formats and clips are extracted from footage every Sunday, so the community distributes the show for us. And we intercept an existing behaviour — Premier League fans already check scores on Saturday — instead of asking anyone to learn a new one.

Echo POV layer

Each week, one moment re-seen from another character's angle as a 30–60s short. Echoes reward observation, pull lurkers one step deeper, and turn the audience into the distribution engine. Echoes never contradict the spine; they recontextualize it.

Production Logic
PRE-PRODUCTION LOCK

Freeze before generate

Model sheets, environment maps, color palettes, and lens specifications are frozen before generation starts.

GENERATIVE EXECUTION

Controlled multiplication

Scene-level prompting with strict negative weighting, control vectors, and reference anchoring to guarantee identity lock.

POST & FINISHING

Human sovereignty

Traditional timeline editorial, human sound design, authentic Foley, and score finishing. AI is a compositing tier inside a film framework.

TECHNICAL SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
Image Integrity Doctrine. Rule 1 — live text stays live; data is never rasterized into an image. Rule 2 — hero slots take one clean portrait. Rule 3 — full sheets live only in the archive with source citations. Rule 4 — diagrams accompany live text, never substitute for it.

Production Pipeline & Cost Reality

Tiered Generation Stack + Live-Action Core

Pipeline Workflow — Script modules to live OBS runtime + cost allocation

Tiered Generative Stack: Higgsfield Genjutsu for consistency-locked character/actor performance transfer; Magnific Desktop for reality-anchored video-to-video finishing; MiniMax H3 Max & GPT Astra for rapid environment and gap-content generation. Local open-weights failover (ComfyUI on ProArt/Puget) ensures zero per-clip bleed and absolute IP sovereignty for restricted FF-4 assets. UE5/Blender for base environment plates. Live action delivers the human core. Built once. Runs forever. Provider-agnostic by design.

Creative Leadership

Studio Nothing Elephant: Author-led vision with sovereign production DNA

Studio Nothing Elephant is an independent creative house based in Nairobi, Kenya, pioneering sovereign African IP through the confluence of deep cultural heritage, investigative journalism, and cutting-edge generative production.

Benjamin Njoroge Thiong'o

Writer, Director, Editor & Founder

Born and raised in the United States. BA in Film/Communications from Emerson College. Worked with Spike Lee, Mira Nair and Tom Fontana in New York City; technical experience at Avid Technologies (industry-standard NLE used by the majority of Hollywood productions). Returns the means of production to African authorship under the Nothing Elephant principle: “There is no situation in life too big to overcome.”

Authored Sovereignty

African storytellers must control artistic production, distribution, and archival memory without intermediary dilution. All core lore, model sheets, and production checkpoints reside in encrypted Kenyan repositories.

Technical Mastery

Proprietary workflows bridging open-source diffusion models, neural rendering, and bespoke physical Foley craft recorded in Kenya.

Risk & Mitigation

Failure modes named. Countermeasures locked.

Operational risk is treated as design input — not a footnote after the ask.

Trigger latency / partner outage

Glass-layer fallback, PARIE provider-agnostic routing, and bottle-episode standbys keep the Saturday window intact.

Character drift

Master-sheet LoRAs + TSM ledger + QC loop. Week 30 must match Week 1 under audit.

Regulatory adjacency

Positioning locked: the poll is narrative, never financial. Any real-money integration requires a licensed operator carrying the liability.

Fixture postponement

Pre-shot standby episodes and de-risked pilot with zero Sportradar dependency.

Platform dependency
